verdict.rationale: Lovable's own docs describe connecting custom MCP servers as chat connectors so Lovable can draw on them while building. Workspace MCP registries let members connect servers in a couple of clicks, and the desktop app adds local MCP server support. Missing for 10: detailed docs on tool invocation beyond reading 'live context', limits or permissions on MCP tool calls, and independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can plug MCP servers into this product so it can use their tools

citations.quote: Lovable can read from it as live context while you build: internal CRMs, private APIs, company knowledge bases, or niche third-party tools.
members then pick servers from it and connect them as chat connectors in a couple of clicks, instead of finding and pasting each server's URL by hand
You get everything in the web app plus local MCP server support, multi-project tabs, and keyboard shortcuts.
